summary: Frontend-only e2e for the new 'We Serve' section on MME site. ALL primary asserts pass. Navbar 'We Serve' hover dropdown lists all 10 categories with correct /we-serve/<slug> hrefs. /we-serve landing renders [data-testid=we-serve-page] (opacity=1) and [data-testid=we-serve-grid] with exactly 10 [data-testid=we-serve-card-<slug>] cards (all 10 expected slugs verified). Each category page renders [data-testid=sub-grid] with correct sub-card counts: cement-plant=7, power-projects=7, chemical-fertilizer=7, steel-projects=7, industrial-construction=7, civil-construction=7, mechanical-works=8, electrical-works=8, balance-of-plant=7, additional-services=8. Spot-checked 5 detail routes (/we-serve/cement-plant/construction, /power-projects/piping, /electrical-works/ht-lt, /mechanical-works/fabrication, /additional-services/technical-consultancy) — each shows [data-testid=we-serve-detail-page] (opacity=1), 'Scope of Work' section, breadcrumbs (Home > We Serve > <Cat> > <Sub> via chevron icons; verified in DOM as 'Home We Serve Cement Plants Cement Plant Construction'), and [data-testid=other-subs] container. Invalid slug graceful redirects work: /we-serve/does-not-exist → /we-serve; /we-serve/cement-plant/bad-sub → /we-serve/cement-plant. Blank-page regression fix holds: in-app link click from Home → We Serve dropdown → category → sub detail shows destination container computed opacity==1 immediately with no reload. 'We Are' subpages (Annual Report) still navigate without regression. Mobile (390px): hamburger opens, 'We Serve' accordion plus button expands to reveal all 10 categories, tapping 'Power Projects' navigates and sub-grid renders with opacity=1 and stacks cleanly (sw==cw==342).
critical_code_review_comments: weServe.js is a single 225-line data file; acceptable now but consider splitting per-category if scope grows further.
Breadcrumbs use chevron icons rather than text separators — screen-reader users may benefit from an aria-label='breadcrumb' on the container (non-blocking a11y suggestion).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 review-request items verified green: navbar dropdown, landing 10 cards, per-category sub-card counts, 5 spot-check detail routes, invalid-slug redirects, blank-page regression (opacity=1 on first SPA nav), 'We Are' subpage no-regression, mobile hamburger + We Serve accordion + navigation. Base URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature works as specified; no bugs found.
